notes: jx.sgcc.com.cn unreachable (pipeline + browser): files are the State Grid 95598.cn static copies (and 寻乌县人民政府 reposts for 2026-04/08) of the official table (2025-11 from a 95598.cn static PDF found later).

TOU per 赣发改价管〔2025〕463号 as restated in note 2 of every monthly table: 1、12月 峰 9-12, 18-21 (尖峰 18-20), 谷 0-6; 2月 峰 16-22, 谷 0-6; 7-9月 峰 17-23 (7、8月 尖峰 20:30-22:30), 谷 1-5, 11:30-14:30 (深谷 12-14); 3-6、10-11月 峰 16-22, 谷 1-5, 11:30-14:30 (深谷 12-14); 春节/五一/国庆 12-14 深谷. 463号's own effective date not verified (in force for the whole range).
Float on 代理购电价格 only: 峰:平:谷 = 1.6:1:0.4, 尖峰 = 平 + 80%·P, 深谷 = 平 − 70%·P. 尖峰/深谷 stored only as printed in the table.
